questions.stem: How many lines of symmetry does a circle have?
questions.solution: A circle has an infinite number of lines of symmetry because any line passing through its center will divide it into two identical halves. The other options are incorrect because they suggest a finite or zero number of lines of symmetry.

hi.stem: एक वृत्त में कितनी सममिति रेखाएँ होती हैं?
hi.solution: एक वृत्त में अनंत सममिति रेखाएँ होती हैं क्योंकि केंद्र से गुजरने वाली कोई भी रेखा इसे दो समान भागों में विभाजित कर देती है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे सममिति रेखाओं की एक सीमित या शून्य संख्या का सुझाव देते हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology.

mr.solution: वर्तुळाला अनंत सममितीच्या रेषा असतात कारण त्याच्या केंद्रामार्गे जाणारी कोणतीही रेषा त्याला दोन एकसारख्या अर्ध्यांमध्ये विभागते. इतर विकल्प चुकीचे आहेत कारण ते सममितीच्या रेषांच्या परिमित वा शून्य संख्येचा अंदाज देतात.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a figure with exactly three lines of symmetry?
choices: A triangle with all sides equal
questions.solution: A triangle with all sides equal, also called an equilateral triangle, has exactly three lines of symmetry. A rectangle has two lines of symmetry, a regular pentagon has five lines of symmetry, and a scalene triangle has no lines of symmetry.

questions.stem: Which of the following shapes has exactly one line of symmetry?
questions.solution: An isosceles triangle has exactly one line of symmetry, which is the line that passes through the vertex angle and the midpoint of the base. The other options have more than one line of symmetry.

questions.stem: A square is folded vertically and then horizontally. If a single straight cut is made, which of the following shapes could appear when the paper is unfolded?
questions.solution: A square folded vertically and then horizontally creates four layers. A single straight cut through all layers will result in a square shape when unfolded because the cut will be mirrored across both folds. A circle, triangle, or star would require more complex cuts or folds. The correct answer is a square.

questions.stem: A figure is folded and a hole is punched in the folded paper. When unfolded, the hole appears in the center of the paper. Which of the following could be the way the paper was folded?

questions.solution: If the hole appears in the center when the paper is unfolded, the paper was likely folded both vertically and horizontally, or vice versa. Folding only vertically or only horizontally would result in the hole being on one side of the paper, not in the center.

questions.stem: A figure has rotational symmetry with the smallest angle of symmetry as 72°. What is the order of rotational symmetry of the figure?
questions.solution: The order of rotational symmetry is the number of times the figure matches itself in a full 360° rotation. This is calculated by dividing 360° by the smallest angle of symmetry. So, 360° ÷ 72° = 5. The order of rotational symmetry is 5. The other options do not match the calculation of 360° ÷ 72°.

hi.solution: घूर्णन सममिति की क्रम आकृति के एक पूर्ण 360° घूर्णन में आकृति के स्वयं के मेल की संख्या होती है। इसे सबसे छोटे सममिति कोण द्वारा 360° के भाग द्वारा गणना की जाती है। अतः 360° ÷ 72° = 5। घूर्णन सममिति की क्रम 5 है। अन्य विकल्प 360° ÷ 72° की गणना के साथ मेल नहीं खाते।

questions.stem: A figure has rotational symmetry with a smallest angle of 45°. Which of the following is a valid statement about this figure?
questions.solution: If the smallest angle of symmetry is 45°, then the total angles of symmetry would be 360° ÷ 45° = 8. Therefore, the figure has 8 angles of symmetry. The other options are not multiples of 45° and do not divide evenly into 360°.

hi.stem: एक आकृति के घूर्णन सममिति का सबसे छोटा कोण 45° है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन इस आकृति के बारे में वैध है?

questions.stem: A figure is folded along a line and the two parts exactly match. What is this line called?
questions.solution: When a figure is folded along a line and the two parts exactly match, the line is called a line of symmetry. This is the definition of a line of symmetry. A line of reflection, rotation, or translation does not match this description.

questions.stem: If a shape has 24 lines of symmetry, what is the maximum possible number of angles of symmetry?
questions.solution: A shape with 24 lines of symmetry can have up to 24 angles of symmetry because each line of symmetry corresponds to an angle of symmetry. The number of angles of symmetry cannot exceed the number of lines of symmetry. Other options suggest more angles than lines, which is not possible.

hi.stem: यदि किसी आकृति में 24 सममिति रेखाएं हैं, तो सममिति के कोणों की अधिकतम संभावित संख्या क्या है?
hi.solution: 24 सममिति रेखाओं वाली आकृति में अधिकतम 24 सममिति कोण हो सकते हैं क्योंकि प्रत्येक सममिति रेखा एक सममिति कोण के साथ संबंधित होती है। सममिति कोणों की संख्या सममिति रेखाओं की संख्या से अधिक नहीं हो सकती। अन्य विकल्प रेखाओं की संख्या से अधिक कोणों के बारे में सुझाव देते हैं, जो संभव नहीं है।
